Malo Demetrii consilio Phillippus de bello Romanis inferedo cogitari.

page.notes: Page is a left-page of a two-column-free text with marginal notes on the right; left-edge stains and show-through from the facing page are omitted. The lower fragment "P 2 atrio-" is the catchword/signature line at the foot and reads "atrio-" as the word broken at the line end; the signature "P 2" is printed below the text. Marginal note text is partly uncertain (e.g. "manorū hostes", "Phillippus", "Malo Demetrii") and should be checked against the scan.
